in_sanskrit.name: Saifuddin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Loyal, Confirming the faith
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saifuddin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Saifuddin is a name of Arabic origin which means 'Loyal, Confirming the faith'. It is derived from two Arabic words 'Saif' meaning sword and 'ud din' meaning confirming the faith.

in_hindi.name: सैफुद्दीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who is victorious in the battlefield (sa'm-pad) and has a generous nature (ud-dīn)
